name: @iyowei/codd-cli
description: Template-driven MongoDB 9.0 provisioning CLI for Podman (Linux / macOS) and Kubernetes (Helm): deterministic hardware sizing formulas, 100% collision-free fingerprint isolation, and interactive terminal wizard. 模板化 MongoDB 9.0 高性能部署装配 CLI。
author: iTonyYo (https://github.com/iTonyYo)

scripts.build: bun scripts/sync-assets.ts && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax --outfile=dist/cli.js && bun scripts/write-dist-manifest.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run verify:release
